title: Add or drop a registered class
description: Adding and dropping are different actions with term-specific deadlines.
descriptionAr: الإضافة والحذف إجراءان مختلفان بمواعيد مرتبطة بالفصل.
verificationNote: Use the current official page for portal labels, applicable term and eligibility. This checklist does not submit a request or verify your private university record. A course drop does not itself establish a refund or transcript grade.
verificationNoteAr: تحقق من المسميات والفصل والأهلية في الصفحة الرسمية الحالية. لا ترسل هذه القائمة الطلب ولا تتحقق من سجلك الجامعي الخاص.
scopeNote: A course drop does not itself establish a refund or transcript grade.

steps.title: Check the term calendar
steps.instruction: Check the term calendar: find the last day to add and the separate last day to withdraw/drop without failure for your intended term.
steps.instructionAr: راجع تقويم الفصل: حدد آخر يوم للإضافة وآخر يوم منفصل للحذف أو الانسحاب دون رسوب للفصل المطلوب.

steps.title: To add
steps.instruction: To add: use Register for Classes → term → Plans → View Sections → Add → Submit, with an Active & Locked plan and cleared restrictions.
steps.instructionAr: للإضافة: استخدم Register for Classes ← الفصل ← Plans ← View Sections ← Add ← Submit، مع خطة مفعلة ومقفلة وإزالة القيود.

steps.title: To drop
steps.instruction: To drop: use the registered section’s Action menu → Drop-Web → Submit, then check the updated schedule.
steps.instructionAr: للحذف: من قائمة Action للشعبة المسجلة اختر Drop-Web ثم Submit، وتحقق من الجدول بعد التعديل.

sources.title: UAEU Academic Calendar
sources.evidenceText: Academic year 2026–27 calendar: Fall 2026 add/drop starts 17 August, last add 28 August, last withdraw/drop without failure 18 September; Spring 2027 corresponding dates 4 January, 15 January and 5 February. General final-exam periods: 6–15 December 2026 and 1–10 May 2027. These are term-specific dates, not individual class/exam appointments or another year's schedule.

sources.title: UAEU Course Registration Service Guide
sources.evidenceText: Official registration guide pages 2–4: advisor must set the Degree Works plan Active & Locked. Open UAEU website > Sign In > MyUAEU > eServices > Student > Student Registration. Check Prepare for Registration/holds. Choose Register for Classes, intended term, Continue, Plans, desired course, View Sections, then Add the section. Add produces Pending, not enrollment; press Submit and verify Registered/Save Successful. Full sections and time conflicts cause errors. Page 5: Closed Section means no seats; a CLOSED SECTION override may be requested, otherwise choose a course with space. Dropping: Action > Drop-Web > Submit. Page 7 says choose Plan, not manual CRN entry.

sources.title: UAEU Withdrawal Deadlines and Financial Obligations
sources.evidenceText: The current Withdrawal Deadlines and Financial Obligations page requires an eService request for university/course withdrawal or registration suspension. Financial obligations follow submission date; refunds follow required clearance. Fall 2026 FULL-SEMESTER courses: 100% refund for requests 24 August–18 September, full tuition responsibility after 18 September. Monthly and quarterly course systems have separate dates. This source does not itself define transcript grades for an individual course.
